newsitem.title: FINLAND: VAAHTO SETS 1 K- FOR 1 A-SHARE BONUS ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: VAAHTO SETS 1 K- FOR 1 A-SHARE BONUS ISSUE.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Vaahto Oy said in a statement on Tuesday it would propose to an extraordinary shareholders meeting in January a bonus issue and a new share series.

The new share series would be called K-shares. In the bonus issue, holders of current A shares would receive one new K share. "The relevant record date of the shares of the bonus issue is January 13, 1997," Vaahto said.
"The board proposes ... to raise the share capital from FIM 7,180,755 to FIM 14,361,510 by issuing bonus shares and by transferring FIM 7,180,755 from the reserve funds to share capital," it said.
The new K shares will have full rights to dividends for the fiscal year starting March 1, 1997, it said, adding a listing on the Helsinki OTC-list would be sought for the new K-shares.
The new K-shares will carry 20 votes each compared to one vote for each A-series share, Vaahto said.
At 1550, Vaahto A traded two markka lower at 121.00.
